title: Camarines Sur earns PCCI citation for business-friendly policies

blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — Camarines Sur earned a special national citation for promoting a business-friendly environment, attracting investments, and generating jobs. The Philippine Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PCCI) conferred the 2026 Most Business-Friendly Local Government Unit Special Citation Award on the provincial government on Tuesday at the Manila Hotel during the 52nd Philippine Business Conference and Exposition. READ: ‘Gov’t continuing reforms to make PH business-friendly’Gov. Luis Raymund “LRay” Villafuerte Jr. said his administration would further improve the province’s investment climate and expand economic opportunities for residents following the recognition. “We welcome investments because investments create businesses.
